Backstory: In Japan year 20XX the Japanese Research and Development Instititute appointed and paid a special scientist to preform the Lazarus project that can resuscitate well preserved bodies three JSDF female soldiers who were killed in combat 1 month ago and their severed heads and headless bodies were brought for the sole purpose of the project and used their heads into the Lazarus chamber and the severed heads were revitalized cellular functions as well was growing new bodies from bone,muscles,organs,skin to the every inch of the body to the fingerprint.

the First who was revived is 1st Lieutenant Himeji(from episode 21 brief appearance shop scene) then second is sergeant Shino Kuribayashi and lastly sergeant Mari Kurokawa and it was very successful experiment that the scientist removed their respective watches from their old headless husk of the corpses and put it in her newly revived and breathing unconscious ladies as a sure way for correct identification for the clean up staff to put the resuscitated ladies to the hospital for check up of vitals while in a coma like state before they woke up once they woke up and ask questions they prepared a cover up story that it was all a dream and they were in a coma for a month.

After the project was a success the ladies were released and return to their duties as soldiers within Japan but their headless well preserved old bodies were now hidden and secured by the Japanese Research and Development Institute to be sold to the private owner for labor or sexual entertainment abroad.
